ask: can u make a bar chart of who voted for what
sentence: A group poll where each person picks one option from a fixed list, shown as bars with vote counts, voter names, and who has not voted yet.
use_when: The group needs to choose one thing from a short list, such as a movie for tonight
Someone wants to see who voted for what as bars
Everyone should get one vote that they can change or take back
You want to see who still has not voted
dont_use_when: People need to pick several options at once or rank them
The options must be typed in by the group instead of fixed in advance
You need a free-text survey, a quiz, or a scheduling grid of dates and times
